description: HAQ failure taxonomy — the ONLY source of truth for DBT failure causes. The LLM may explain these causes but may never invent new ones.

NAME_MISMATCH.label: Beneficiary name mismatch across Aadhaar / bank / scheme records
NAME_MISMATCH.label_hi: आधार, बैंक और योजना रिकॉर्ड में नाम अलग है
NAME_MISMATCH.description: Name on Aadhaar does not match bank records or scheme application character-by-character. B06 rejection blocks Aadhaar seeding until the bank record is corrected.

signals.text: Identity graph shows name fields differ between documents
PFMS returned ACCOUNT_VALIDATION_FAILED
Bank/NPCI returned B06 name mismatch

CLOSED_MAPPED_ACCOUNT.label: NPCI mapper points to a closed bank account
CLOSED_MAPPED_ACCOUNT.label_hi: एनपीसीआई मैपर बंद खाते की ओर इशारा कर रहा है
CLOSED_MAPPED_ACCOUNT.description: The Aadhaar in the NPCI mapper is linked to an account the bank reports as closed. Credits are returned to the sponsor bank/government.

signals.text: NPCI mapper status is not 'Enabled for DBT'
Bank system reports account closed
APBS returned the credit

DORMANT_MAPPED_ACCOUNT.label: Mapped account is dormant / inactive (reactivable)
DORMANT_MAPPED_ACCOUNT.label_hi: लिंक्ड खाता निष्क्रिय (डोरमेंट) है — इसे फिर से सक्रिय किया जा सकता है
DORMANT_MAPPED_ACCOUNT.description: Account exists but has had no customer-initiated transaction for a long period, so banks mark it dormant/inoperative and reject DBT credits. Unlike a closed account it can be reactivated with a small deposit/withdrawal and KYC.

signals.text: NPCI mapper status is not 'Enabled for DBT'
Bank reports account dormant/inoperative
Passbook evidence shows account activity after the alleged closure — account is dormant, not closed

AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.label: Aadhaar not seeded in NPCI mapper for DBT
AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.label_hi: आधार एनपीसीआई मैपर में डीबीटी के लिए सीड नहीं है
AADHAAR_NOT_SEEDED.description: Aadhaar is not mapped to any bank account as the DBT destination ('UID never enabled for DBT'). Seeding request must be made at the preferred bank branch (Annexure I).

signals.text: NPCI mapper shows no active DBT mapping
APBS returned the credit — no mapping

PAYMENT_MAPPED_TO_OTHER_ACCOUNT.label: DBT is being routed to a different bank account than expected
PAYMENT_MAPPED_TO_OTHER_ACCOUNT.label_hi: भुगतान किसी दूसरे बैंक खाते में जा रहा है
PAYMENT_MAPPED_TO_OTHER_ACCOUNT.description: DBT follows the LATEST Aadhaar-seeded account in the NPCI mapper. A newer seeding request has silently redirected payments to another account.

signals.text: Mapper shows more than one known account for this Aadhaar
Scheme portal shows credit to an account different from the beneficiary's stated account

ACCOUNT_VALIDATION_FAILED.label: Account validation failed at PFMS/bank
ACCOUNT_VALIDATION_FAILED.description: PFMS could not validate the account: name, account number or IFSC in the application does not match bank records, or the bank is not mapped.

signals.text: PFMS returned ACCOUNT_VALIDATION_FAILED
Identity graph shows name fields differ — the most common trigger of account validation failure

INVALID_IFSC.label: Invalid or outdated IFSC (bank merger/branch change)
INVALID_IFSC.label_hi: आईएफएससी कोड गलत या पुराना है
INVALID_IFSC.description: IFSC in the scheme record belongs to a merged/restructured branch. Payment cannot be routed until the scheme record is updated.

signals.text: IFSC flagged invalid/unmapped by PFMS/bank source
Passbook shows pre-merger IFSC

EKYC_PENDING.label: Mandatory eKYC pending with the scheme
EKYC_PENDING.description: Scheme (e.g. PM-KISAN) withholds installments until OTP/face eKYC is completed. Fix at portal/CSC — no bank visit needed for this cause.

signals.text: Scheme portal reports eKYC pending/not done

LIFE_CERTIFICATE_PENDING.label: Annual life certificate not submitted (pension stoppage risk)
LIFE_CERTIFICATE_PENDING.label_hi: वार्षिक जीवन प्रमाणपत्र जमा नहीं हुआ है
LIFE_CERTIFICATE_PENDING.description: Pensions are stopped every year if the life certificate is not submitted before the deadline (typically 30 November). This is a SEPARATE stoppage risk and must be scheduled even when another cause explains the current failure.

signals.text: Case is a pension scheme
Scheme portal shows life certificate pending

APBS_PAYMENT_RETURNED.label: Payment released but returned by the payment rail
APBS_PAYMENT_RETURNED.description: Scheme and PFMS show the payment as processed, but APBS returned it (reason code attached). Usually downstream of mapper/account problems.

signals.text: APBS status: returned

SCHEME_NOT_RELEASED.label: Scheme has not released the payment yet
SCHEME_NOT_RELEASED.label_hi: योजना ने अभी भुगतान जारी नहीं किया है
SCHEME_NOT_RELEASED.description: Failure is at the scheme's own approval/disbursement stage (application pending, eligibility verification, sanction order). Bank-side fixes will not help.

signals.text: Scheme portal shows payment pending/not released

OTHER.label: Unclassified failure — needs manual evidence
OTHER.label_hi: कारण स्पष्ट नहीं — और प्रमाण चाहिए
OTHER.description: Signals do not match a documented cause with confidence. Plan focuses on evidence collection and standard escalation.
